name: qfd_vm_xpad2_w-xpw1-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen TP8 VM x-lane PAD leaf, MIRRORED PINS (d on E, q on W) for the westward pad visits: the same module and parameters as the closed qfd_vm_xpad2_t (two me-enabled stages of 480 b), so a westward pad pair is face to face instead of a U-turn round its 17.28-um tile (5,845 pad U-turn pairs in vm_bay_tiles_claude.json). Bench = the pad leaf bench + 2 mutants (unchanged).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qfd_vm_xpad2_t #(.W(480), .MEREG(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/ot_qfd_vm_xpad2.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/ot_qfd_vm_xplane.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_vm_xpad2_w/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_vm_xpad2_w/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_vm_xpad2_w --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qfd_vm_xpad2_t  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

reroute_reason.slot_change_request: el1011-qwen-tp8.log 2026-10-13 PLAN: VM SLOT CHANGE REQUEST v2 (bit-plane VM, die-assembled leaves: regions of bank / SU / FIFO leaves with per-consumer control leaves, one row of 32 xcol leaves in the band, relay strips)
reroute_reason.why: mirrored pin faces (d on E, q on W) for westward pad visits; the closed qfd_vm_xpad2_t view has d on W, q on E (VM4 3a: 5,845 pad pairs turn round their tile)
